mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 82 degrees with partly cloudy skies near Badger Prairie County Park, and the current moon phase is the Third Quarter.

Construction on highway M moves into phase two the week of September 7, which will shift traffic patterns for the next few weeks, while the city has also unveiled a new Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School Park.
There is plenty to do with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and more music happening tomorrow.
On August 30, an officer observed a vehicle and bicyclist collision at East Verona Avenue and Lincoln Street, resulting in a citation for the driver.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Chocolate Volcano and the restaurant is open for business today until 10:30 PM, so head over soon to enjoy your dessert.
